variants.headline: Full shelves, empty household purses
variants.body: Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.body: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Hunger beside food that cannot be afforded
